purpose: Executable checks of materialized opcode records and exact within-record motion. All-size correctness is kernel-proved separately. No native machine-time or expanding-family existence claim.
trajectory_checks: For every page, every vertex and every s=0,...,7R, sequential native Dir.shift motion equals the pulse walk; all page positions vanish at the final horizon.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.RationalOpcodeWalk
import TransposeFollowup.RationalSymmetricGraph
open TransposeFollowup

def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def exampleFamily : Fin 3 → RationalMobius := ![identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap]

def recordSummary (n : Nat) : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  let tape := rationalOpcodeTape exampleFamily n
  (tape.length, (tape.filter (· == PageOpcode.openEdge)).length,
    (tape.filter (· == PageOpcode.closeEdge)).length,
    (rationalFamilyEdgeStream exampleFamily n).length)

def recordCheck (n : Nat) : Bool :=
  let table := rationalOpcodeTable exampleFamily n
  let ops := fun u p => (table.get u).get p
  let R := 2
  let offset := 3
  let walk := opcodeRampWalk R offset ops
  (List.finRange (rationalPageCount exampleFamily)).all (fun p =>
    walk p (offset + 7 * R * (2 * n)) == 0 &&
    (List.finRange (2 * n)).all (fun u =>
      let t := offset + 7 * R * u.val
      (List.range (7 * R + 1)).all (fun s =>
        recordRun R (ops u p) (walk p t) s == walk p (t + s))))

#eval (List.range 9).map recordSummary
#eval (List.range 7).map recordCheck
#eval ((rationalOpcodeTable (fun _ : Fin 1 => identityMap) 4).toList.map List.Vector.toList)
